scenario: On one operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2 sample, verify normal-image WPA2-PSK and strict-SAE completion, IPv4/DNS configuration, gateway reachability, scan continuity, a requested ROAM reaching a new authorized association, and configured NOR multiuser network startup.
expected: Both handshakes complete; network configuration and basic reachability remain available in bounded checks, including after the normal NOR boot path; a requested ROAM reaches a new authorized WPA_COMPLETED association.
observed: Earlier bounded checks on this V1.2 sample reached WPA_COMPLETED with strict SAE and WPA2-PSK; DHCPv4, DNS, and gateway ICMP passed in bounded checks. A prior ordinary NOR boot with an earlier root confirmed automatic WPA3/DHCP startup and basic network access. The 65,536-byte TCP roundtrip with matching host SHA-256 and earlier bounded mDNS no-response checks were on root d38bb7a2. On 2026-11-14, the 10 MiB root 9c55 was written to LittleFS at 0x600000; built-in hash verification passed. An ordinary POWER boot with the existing persistent FIT reached root on flash1. The SAE baseline reached COMPLETED. A 16-row scan found two exact same-ESS SAE alternatives, and the selected candidate matched the request. The ROAM request returned OK and produced association generation 11; the adapter accepted the first EAPOL frame. Authorization completion was not observed, and the connection ended before WPA_COMPLETED. The driver reported state transition INIT with argument 1, followed by DISCONNECTED at the deadline. A bounded host ping lost all packets, and the router showed no association for the target. Host mDNS A and AAAA queries received no response within four seconds. The partial mDNS state dump reported Sent=0, Received=0, UP=1 but was incomplete; no complete table state is inferred. Restoring the stock mDNS service returned OK. WIFI_PROBE_DONE was not captured, so the probe did not produce a completion marker.

limits: One operator-reported V1.2 sample; this does not establish support for other revisions.
SAE remained COMPLETED for about five minutes during an earlier bounded session; this does not establish long-duration reliability.
A 65,536-byte TCP transfer and return passed with matching host SHA-256 on the earlier d38bb7a2 root; throughput and sustained reliability were not measured.
802.11k/v/r and BTM/RRM behavior are under investigation and were not validated here.
No forged-frame protection test has been completed.
STATUS pmf=1 means AP MFPC set/MFPR clear; local ieee80211w=2 is the independent required-PMF policy.
The SAE AP observer had no capture delta; SAE completion and IGTK installation rely on supplicant/driver reports, not independent AP-side capture.

Root 9c55 passed normal POWER boot to LittleFS flash1 with the existing persistent FIT. Following ROAM, the adapter accepted the first EAPOL frame, but authorization completion and reconnection were not observed before the connection ended ahead of WPA_COMPLETED; host ping lost all packets. Root cause is undetermined.
The partial mDNS dump is incomplete and does not establish the complete service table. Host A/AAAA queries timed out; the stock mDNS service was restored successfully.
WIFI_PROBE_DONE was not captured; this run has no completion marker and does not constitute full Wi-Fi or roaming acceptance.
